review_notes: Partition unchanged and verified: 17 source / 21 target, each used once. Only the target head of the עֲגִילִים unit moved, from t010 *ear* to t011 *rings*.

The accepted head reasoned that *rings alone is any ring*, which is the דry-land test; but *ring* is what the lexeme already names and *ear* specifies where it hangs, so rule 31's sea-monsters half governs and the head belongs on the noun.
This also brings the verse into line with the chapter's other supplied-noun phrases, where the head sits on the word carrying the lexeme (*fine linen* → *linen*, *fine flour* → *flour*).
